protocol_deviation_disclosure: Two protocol deviations occurred prior to unmasking and are disclosed upfront: (1) PREREGISTRATION.md Section 2.4 specified 3 distinct model families, whereas grok_4_7 refused the task, leaving 2 model families represented across 3 sessions: two Gemini runs (s1 = gemini_hydrogen, s3 = gemini_carbon; 78/78 retrieved live on 2026-11-14) and one Anthropic run (s2 = opus_5_5), giving Gemini 2/3 of the majority vote (direction_class_maj). (2) In s2 (opus_5_5), anti-bot blocking prevented live etymonline.com retrieval after W003, so only 3/78 items (W001 theory, W002 sound, W003 friction) were verified live on 2026-11-14 and 75/78 items (W004..W078) were coded from parametric memory marked 'unverified', including all 10/10 target words, 38/40 control words, and 34/35 ledger_physics_35 words. All session codings were committed at part3_pre_unmasking_commit_sha before joining with word_coding_key.csv.
